summary: Verified fix for the ToolsPage 'tools appear then disappear / stuck on Lade Tools' bug caused by React.StrictMode double-mount aborting the first XHR. Ran a comprehensive Playwright suite against the public preview URL: initial /tools load, 3 consecutive reloads, alias routes /kostenlose-analyse and /analyse, service filter (cyber-security) and filter-all restore, and clicking tool-card-kostenrechner. In every scenario the tools-grid rendered exactly 16 cards, remained stable for +3s after initial render, no tools-load-error banner appeared, and no console/page errors were observed. 'Alle Tools' pill correctly shows count 16. Cyber-security filter reduces to 1 card and filter-all restores 16. Clicking the kostenrechner card renders the Website-Kostenrechner widget below while the 16-card grid stays visible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ToolsPage StrictMode double-mount fix confirmed working. Backend GET /api/tools returns 16 enabled tools. All data-testid selectors used in review request are present: tools-grid, tool-card-<slug>, tools-load-error (not shown), filter-all, filter-cyber-security. If retesting, use networkidle wait plus a +2-3s stability check to catch any regression where StrictMode remount blanks the grid.
rca of the issue: Prior bug: React 18 StrictMode mounts effects twice in dev; original fetchTools used a single-fire AbortController whose first mount abort caused net::ERR_ABORTED and left state in loading/empty. Fix (already in place per files_of_reference) uses AbortController with retry, so the second mount successfully populates state. Testing confirms grid populates and remains stable across reloads and alias routes.
